description: This PHP source file defines the AORReportsDashlet class, which extends the Dashlet class to implement a custom dashboard component in the SuiteCRM platform. It manages configuration, display, chart generation, and options for a report dashlet within the AOR_Reports module.

classes.name: AORReportsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying reports and charts within the SuiteCRM dashboard. It handles configuration, rendering, and interaction with report data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with provided configuration, loads associated report, and sets up parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the Smarty template for rendering the dashlet, including chart HTML and parameters.

methods.name: getChartHTML
methods.description: Returns the HTML code for the report's chart, or an empty string if no report is loaded.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Placeholder method for processing actions, currently empty.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration options template for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves and sanitizes user-defined options for the dashlet.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Returns true, indicating unrestricted access to the dashlet.
